title: What My Pipeline becomes
question: Three structures for the closer's own desk: their money, their open deals, and a lookup of every deal. Lock one, steer it, or ask for another hand.

options.label: Desk by program
options.lineage: How a high-ticket sales floor talks: by program
options.thesis: Your desk split by the programs you sell: each one's money this month and its open deals, then every deal in a lookup.
options.viewport: Navy strip: cash this month vs this time last month, wins, open deals. Then one section per program (Accelerator, Elite Mentorship): its cash and wins this month, and its open deals as rows with stage, last activity and next step. Below: All deals, the filterable lookup.
options.risk: A closer who sells one program gets one section, which is just a list.

raised.raise: Each row's stage word changes in place, in the board's condensed caps, and rows never jump.
One alert colour (amber) is reserved for open deals with no next step.

options.label: My month
options.thesis: Your month on top, your open deals under it, every deal one tab away.
options.viewport: Navy month band: cash collected, payments, wins and close rate this month against this time last month, with week-by-week figures. Below, tabs Open deals / All deals: open deals grouped Booked, Call held, Follow-up with last activity and next step; All deals is the lookup.
options.risk: Repeats Today's Performance card unless the month band says more than it does.

options.label: Deal timeline
options.lineage: A brokerage statement: running total over dated entries
options.thesis: Everything that happened on your deals, newest first, with your month's running total pinned on top.
options.viewport: Pinned navy total: cash this month and wins. Under it, a dated ledger of events across your deals: payment recorded +$3,500, call held, no-show, deal lost, task set; filters by event and program. A Deals toggle turns the ledger into the lookup of all deals.
options.risk: Deals are read through events, so finding one deal's state takes a toggle.

options.label: Split-flap concourse
options.thesis: Rows ranked by time; columns never move; state restyles in place.
options.risk: A costume on a working page.
options.case: Already Magnus's signature on Today; a deal book isn't a departures list.
options.kept: Status restyles a cell in place without moving the grid.

options.label: Boarding pass and gate board
options.thesis: A pass with a sequence number beside a board that reranks in place.
options.risk: A costume on a working page.
options.case: Fuses toward the board Magnus already has; the pass adds a costume, not clarity.
options.kept: One alert colour reserved for what changed.

options.label: Convention circle catalog
options.thesis: Stamp-size cells keyed to a hall map.
options.risk: A costume on a working page.
options.case: A closer has tens of deals, not thousands; the grid has nothing to pack.
options.kept: The marked cell: the current item circled.

options.label: Zoo guide map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.risk: A costume on a working page.
options.case: Maps space, and a pipeline has no geography.
options.kept: Flat, unmodulated colour fields for groups.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.thesis: Giant lowercase, colour tiles as content.
options.risk: A costume on a working page.
options.case: Display type and chromeless tiles fight a dense working page.
options.kept: Type carries the interface; chrome deleted.

options.label: Orienteering map
options.thesis: Standard inks; the course rides in purple over everything.
options.risk: A costume on a working page.
options.case: Terrain notation has no reading for deals or money.
options.kept: One reserved ink for the active leg.
